narrative.overview:
Access control is shown as a pass, not a policy file. A lanyard card hangs from a peg rail, names a team, and lists three zones the holder may enter; the page around it is cool paper and ink, with hairline and heavy ink rules like printed credential stock. The surface is flat, legible and slightly stern, which fits a security proxy that fails closed and says plainly that it is pre-alpha.

Three zone colours carry fixed meaning everywhere on the site: orange is metrics, blue is logs, lime is traces. Hatched ink means denied. Nothing else on the site is allowed to use those three hues for decoration, so a colour is always a statement about scope. Archivo, wide and heavy, does the lettering of passes and headings; JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is a query, YAML or a reason code.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, ink text, one ink hairline vocabulary (1px at 20% ink, 3px solid ink for structure).
Three zone colours with fixed meaning; denied is a 135-degree ink hatch.
Wide, heavy Archivo for headings and pass lettering; mono only for machine text.
Flat surfaces, no gradients as decoration, no glass; one soft drop shadow under the pass.
One authored motion: the pass settling on its lanyard.

rules.name: The Zone Meaning Rule
rules.body: Orange, blue and lime mean metrics, logs and traces and nothing else. They are not accents, not link colours, not syntax highlighting. Code syntax is monochrome on purpose.

rules.name: The Denied Hatch Rule
rules.body: Refusal is a 135-degree hatch of ink at low alpha (or paper on the dark rewrite strip), never a red.

rules.name: The Mono Is Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for queries, YAML, status/reason codes and inline code, never for prose or decoration.

rules.name: The Width Is Voice Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from Archivo's width and weight axes; do not add a second display face.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Only the pass lifts. Cards, bands and code blocks stay flat.

dos: Do use orange, blue and lime only for metrics, logs and traces respectively, and the hatch for denied.
Do set machine text (queries, YAML, status codes) in JetBrains Mono and everything else in Archivo.
Do build structure from ink rules: 1px hairline for rows, 3px solid for section and table heads.
Do keep controls as 2.5px ink-bordered pills at 44px or larger, with the paper-halo focus ring.
Do keep motion to the pass settling and the stamp on matchers, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do state pre-alpha status plainly wherever the product is described.
donts: Don't use zone colours as decoration, link colour or syntax highlighting.
Don't use red or any other hue for denied; use the hatch.
Don't add gradients or glass for decoration; the only gradients are the denied hatch and the three-colour all-zones stripe.
Don't lift cards or panels with shadows; the pass is the only raised object.
Don't fall back to a dark developer-tools hero with an install snippet and a row of feature cards.
